title: Dielectrics in an Electric Field: Two Types of Dielectric
printed_title: 71. Dielectrics in an Electric Field: Two Types of Dielectric

prose.text:
The electrons and atomic nuclei in a dielectric carry charge, but these charges are mainly bound by atomic, molecular, or crystal structure and cannot migrate throughout the material as free charges can in an ideal conductor.
The source explains this distinction using atoms or molecules that are electrically neutral overall;
overall neutrality does not mean the absence of charged particles inside.

Under the applicable insulating, electrostatic approximation, an applied field can slightly change the distribution of bound charges or affect the orientations of existing electric dipoles. This response is called polarization.
A real dielectric may also conduct weakly or undergo electrical breakdown, so ideal insulation is not an absolute property under every condition.
prose.source_text: 电介质是由从整体来说是中性的原子或分子组成的. 在中性原子中的电荷(确切地说是带电粒子：电子和原子核)是彼此相互联系着的，并且不可能象导体中的自由电荷那样在物质整个体积内自由地移动.

prose.text:
**Electric fields in a dielectric**.
At electrostatic equilibrium, the total field within the conducting material of an ideal conductor, where free charge can migrate, is zero. A field can generally still exist inside a dielectric.

After a dielectric is polarized, the field of its bound charges and the field of the external sources together determine the total field.
The ideal point-charge model in §64 gives the interaction force as $\frac{1}{\varepsilon}$ of the corresponding vacuum value when the free-charge distribution is fixed, a homogeneous linear isotropic dielectric fills the region considered, and boundaries, charged-body sizes, and local effects are neglected.

Here, the dielectric constant means relative permittivity. Its value depends on the material and the conditions, and is not a universal constant for every real medium.
From $\vec{F}=q\vec{E}$, for the same test charge that approximately does not disturb the original field, reducing the force magnitude to $\frac{1}{\varepsilon}$ of its vacuum value reduces the corresponding macroscopic field magnitude to $\frac{1}{\varepsilon}$ of that value.

These ratios belong to the ideal macroscopic electrostatic model above;
they do not directly give every mechanical force on a conductor in an arbitrary medium.

In this field-reduction case, the additional polarization field inside the dielectric opposes the original field. This does not mean that the total internal field points opposite to the original field.
Superposition is generally a vector sum: the additional field need not oppose the original field everywhere, and opposition is not the only way to change a field.

A dielectric with no net charge can still produce a field through changes in its internal charge distribution. It does not create net charge from nothing.
prose.source_text: 导体和电介质的结构不同，导致了它们自己内部的电场不同. 在电介质内部，可以有电场，因此，电介质对外电场有一定的影响. 在§64中曾讲过，在均匀电介质中，带电体间的相互作用力要减小到 $\frac{1}{\varepsilon}$ 倍. 因为 $\vec{F}=q\vec{E}$，所以，力减小到 $\frac{1}{\varepsilon}$ 倍就意味着电介质中的场强减小到 $\frac{1}{\varepsilon}$ 倍. 根据场的叠加原理，电介质中某点的场强，只有在给原有电场附加一个相反方向的新电场时，才可能改变. 因此，**不带电的电介质产生电场，其内部电场的方向与带电体产生的电场方向相反**.

prose.text:
**A qualitative electroscope demonstration**.
Figure 128 shows the charged electroscope in the source, with a metal disk connected to the stem and leaves.
The source reports that bringing an initially neutral dielectric, such as thick glass, near the disk reduces the leaf opening (Figure 129).

Interpret this using a model in which the electroscope is insulated from its surroundings, the dielectric does not touch the metal, there is no significant charge leakage, and electrostatic equilibrium has approximately been reached. The change results from the effect of dielectric polarization on the field and the distribution of charge on the conductor surface.
The electroscope's total charge stays fixed, but its charge is redistributed. Under the illustrated conditions, the charge magnitude on the leaves decreases and that on the disk increases correspondingly;
charge has not moved into the glass.

The leaf angle is determined jointly by electrical forces, gravity, and support forces. A smaller angle does not mean that every electrical force has vanished.
The angle change alone cannot uniquely rule out contact, leakage, or other causes. The conditions stated above are prerequisites for this qualitative explanation.

The source demonstration is retained as a read-only description. It does not ask the learner to charge or operate the apparatus, or infer unstated charge signs or counts from the figure.
prose.source_text: 利用简单的实验，可以证实不带电的电介质能够产生电场. 在图128上，你可以看到一只在轴上端装有金属圆盘的带电的验电器. 如果把一个电介质，例如厚的玻璃，拿近这个验电器的圆盘，则验电器的金箔渐渐地降下(图129). 只有在放到带电圆盘的电场中的电介质本身产生电场的情况下，才能有这种现象. 这个电场影响了验电器轴上电荷的分布，金箔的电荷减少了，而圆盘上的电荷相应地增加了.

prose.text:
**Electrical properties of atoms and molecules**.
To understand how an electrically neutral dielectric can produce a polarization field, distinguish net charge from the spatial distribution of its internal positive and negative charges.
The following discussion considers these distributions in atoms or molecules and the simplified models used by the source to explain the distinction.
prose.source_text: 为了理解不带电的电介质是怎样产生电场的，首先需要知道中性原子和分子的电性质.

prose.text:
Atoms and molecules contain positively charged atomic nuclei and negatively charged electrons.
Figure 130 uses the simplified hydrogen picture in the source, with positive charge concentrated at the nucleus.
The source explains average charge distribution using classical electron circulation around the nucleus, giving an orbit time of order $10^{-16}$ seconds.

It then uses $10^{-9}$ seconds as an example, describing a million completed revolutions and a million visits to the symmetric points 1 and 2 relative to the nucleus.
These time scales and counts retain the source values, but must not be interpreted as real modern atomic trajectories, precise counts, or results strictly derived from the printed times.
Modern quantum theory does not assign this definite path around the nucleus to an atomic electron.

For ground-state hydrogen with no external field, the electron probability distribution is spherically symmetric;
the center of the average negative charge distribution coincides with the positive charge center at the nucleus.

This is a property of a particular atomic state, not a claim that every atomic state has exactly the same symmetry.
The dashed marks in Figure 131 retain the source schematic for explaining the average distribution;
they are not a series of directly measured electron orbit positions.
prose.source_text: 原子和分子是由带正电的粒子——原子核和带负电的粒子——电子组成的. 简单的原子——氢原子，如图130所示.原子的正电荷，它的原子核的电荷，集中在原子的中心. 电子在原子中以很大的速度运动. 电子绕原子核转一圈用很短的时间，数量级为 $10^{-16}$ 秒. 因此，例如在 $10^{-9}$ 秒内它完成了一百万圈，从而经过相对于原子核对称的两个任意点1和2有一百万次. 这就可以认为：对时间平均来说，负电荷分布的中心是在原子核的中间，即与带正电的原子核重合(图131，虚线表示电子的一系列位置).

prose.text: Figure 130
prose.label: 图130

prose.text: Figure 131
prose.label: 图131

prose.text:
**An ion pair and an electric dipole**.
The source uses the sodium and chlorine constituents of table salt, NaCl: the sodium atom has one outer valence electron, while the chlorine atom has seven.
In the simplified electron-transfer model of the source, sodium loses this valence electron and chlorine gains it, forming a pair of oppositely charged ions (Figure 132).

This model only illustrates that overall electrical neutrality and local charge separation can coexist.
Solid table salt has an ionic lattice structure, not a collection of separate neutral molecules. The illustrated ion pair does not replace the interactions in the complete lattice.

To describe the field far from an isolated ion pair, approximate each ion's net charge as concentrated at its position, treating the pair as equal and opposite point charges separated by $l$.
The observation distance should be much greater than both their separation and the ion sizes.
Figure 133 shows this simplified **electric dipole**: its net charge is zero, but its positive and negative charges have different positions, so it can still produce a field.

This is an idealized ion-pair representation. It does not supply a scale for a real crystal, additional ion counts, or new measurements.
prose.source_text: 然而，情况并不都是这样. 现在我们研究食盐 NaCl 的分子. 钠原子的最外层有一个价电子，它与原子的联系较弱.氯有七个价电子. 当形成分子时，钠的唯一的价电子被氯俘获. 两个中性原子变为由两个带相反符号电荷的离子组成的系统(图132). 正电荷和负电荷这时不是按分子的体积对称分布：正电荷的分布中心是在钠离子上，而负电荷的分布中心是在氯离子上. 在远离分子的地方，可以近似地把它看作为彼此相距为 $l$ 的两个等值异号的点电荷的总和(图133).这种整体来说是中性的电荷系统，叫做电偶极子.

prose.text: Figure 132
prose.label: 图132

prose.text: Figure 133
prose.label: 图133

prose.text:
**Two classes of molecular dielectric**.
The source next classifies molecules by whether they have a permanent electric dipole moment with no external field.
This molecular classification is useful for discussing polarization, but it is not an exhaustive classification of all dielectric microstructures, including ionic crystals.

**Polar-molecule dielectrics**.
Without an external field, the positive and negative charge centers in each polar molecule do not coincide, and the molecule has a permanent electric dipole moment.
Even when individual molecules have permanent dipoles, their orientations can cancel one another because of thermal motion. This alone does not establish a common macroscopic polarization throughout the material.
prose.source_text: 极性分子电介质. 在组成这种电介质的分子中，正电荷和负电荷的分布中心不相重合；

prose.text:
**Nonpolar-molecule dielectrics**.
Without an external field, the positive and negative charge centers in the atoms or nonpolar molecules considered here coincide, and there is no permanent electric dipole moment.
An external field can still change the internal charge distribution and induce a dipole moment. Having no permanent dipole does not mean that polarization is impossible, or that charged particles are absent.
prose.source_text: 无极分子电介质. 在组成这种电介质的原子或分子中，正电荷和负电荷的分布中心是重合的.

prose.text: 电介质是由从整体来说是中性的原子或分子组成的. 在中性原子中的电荷(确切地说是带电粒子：电子和原子核)是彼此相互联系着的，并且不可能象导体中的自由电荷那样在物质整个体积内自由地移动.

导体和电介质的结构不同，导致了它们自己内部的电场不同. 在电介质内部，可以有电场，因此，电介质对外电场有一定的影响. 在§64中曾讲过，在均匀电介质中，带电体间的相互作用力要减小到 $\frac{1}{\varepsilon}$ 倍. 因为 $\vec{F}=q\vec{E}$，所以，力减小到 $\frac{1}{\varepsilon}$ 倍就意味着电介质中的场强减小到 $\frac{1}{\varepsilon}$ 倍. 根据场的叠加原理，电介质中某点的场强，只有在给原有电场附加一个相反方向的新电场时，才可能改变. 因此，**不带电的电介质产生电场，其内部电场的方向与带电体产生的电场方向相反**.
利用简单的实验，可以证实不带电的电介质能够产生电场. 在图128上，你可以看到一只在轴上端装有金属圆盘的带电的验电器. 如果把一个电介质，例如厚的玻璃，拿近这个验电器的圆盘，则验电器的金箔渐渐地降下(图129). 只有在放到带电圆盘的电场中的电介质本身产生电场的情况下，才能有这种现象. 这个电场影响了验电器轴上电荷的分布，金箔的电荷减少了，而圆盘上的电荷相应地增加了.
为了理解不带电的电介质是怎样产生电场的，首先需要知道中性原子和分子的电性质.

原子和分子是由带正电的粒子——原子核和带负电的粒子——电子组成的. 简单的原子——氢原子，如图130所示.原子的正电荷，它的原子核的电荷，集中在原子的中心. 电子在原子中以很大的速度运动. 电子绕原子核转一圈用很短的时间，数量级为 $10^{-16}$ 秒. 因此，例如在 $10^{-9}$ 秒内它完成了一百万圈，从而经过相对于原子核对称的两个任意点1和2有一百万次. 这就可以认为：对时间平均来说，负电荷分布的中心是在原子核的中间，即与带正电的原子核重合(图131，虚线表示电子的一系列位置).

然而，情况并不都是这样. 现在我们研究食盐 NaCl 的分子. 钠原子的最外层有一个价电子，它与原子的联系较弱.氯有七个价电子. 当形成分子时，钠的唯一的价电子被氯俘获. 两个中性原子变为由两个带相反符号电荷的离子组成的系统(图132). 正电荷和负电荷这时不是按分子的体积对称分布：正电荷的分布中心是在钠离子上，而负电荷的分布中心是在氯离子上. 在远离分子的地方，可以近似地把它看作为彼此相距为 $l$ 的两个等值异号的点电荷的总和(图133).这种整体来说是中性的电荷系统，叫做电偶极子.
电介质可以分为两类：
极性分子电介质. 在组成这种电介质的分子中，正电荷和负电荷的分布中心不相重合；
无极分子电介质. 在组成这种电介质的原子或分子中，正电荷和负电荷的分布中心是重合的.
